description.value: Chef Hung Taiwanese Beef Noodle is the North American flagship of an international chain founded by a three-time champion of the Taipei International Beef Noodle Festival Competition (2007–2010). The restaurant serves traditional Taiwanese beef noodle soup made with premium beef cuts and noodles imported from Taiwan, developed through the founder's 20 years of culinary research. It sits in Richmond's dense Asian food district, offering touring cyclists a distinctive regional dining experience.
